title: MCP tasks in the terminal, deny instead of prompting, auto mode changes
headline: MCP tool calls run as background tasks in the terminal, a new setting denies calls instead of prompting, auto mode tightens behind gateways, and many permission and sandbox gaps are closed.

lines.text: Auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways, now asks about or denies calls the server can't check instead of falling back to the built-in classifier (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 keeps it; Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged). Behind a gateway, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1 enables the server check even with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS set, and managed settings that set the latter must also set the 1.

MCP tasks in the terminal: when a server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background at once and tells Claude the result when it's done. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND makes it wait inside the call instead.
New setting permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting: instead of stopping to ask, a tool call that needs permission is refused and the turn keeps going, in the terminal, subagents and teammates.
New /claude-api latency-optimize command: it looks for slow spots in your Claude API code and tests faster settings against your eval.
Set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS to skip downloading feature flags while keeping telemetry on; all flags fall back to their defaults.
/usage shows today's, this week's and this month's spend for developers behind a Claude apps gateway (this version or later) who have no spend limit.

Claude apps gateway: admin.pooled_conflict_rule and admin.pooled_priority_order choose which pooled group budget pays first, login_notice shows an operator message on the verification page and Claude Code's sign-in screen, and CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json writes log lines as JSON with severity, time and message.

Claude apps gateway start-up warnings: when another policy's availableModels also allows a custom model id one policy lists by name, for policies without desktopHome that rely on coworkTabEnabled: false or chatSessionRetentionDays (ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change), for upstreams mixing AWS GovCloud with others or base URL variables in its environment, and when managed settings name a Bedrock guardrail in a header with no bedrock upstream setting a guardrail.

When Claude Code uses the sign-in from ant auth login, a startup line names the Claude Console organization being billed, and a warning appears if your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on that sign-in.
/tasks gets an "Earlier in this session" row listing finished subagents, so you can reopen and message one after it leaves the list or after a restart.
In cloud sessions, confirming a /loop now warns that its timer ends when the container does, and offers a loop that keeps running.

MCP: servers on the older handshake connect and return results again, since Claude Code no longer declares an extension it only uses with newer servers, and a long-running claude.ai connector call reports its result after --resume.
A file or folder named HEAD no longer breaks diffs: on claude.ai and the mobile apps, in /diff at the repository top level. /diff also no longer opens blank after 64 or more editing turns.
Slash commands typed after a leading space, tab or newline run instead of being sent as text.
A request that keeps getting 401 errors no longer refreshes your login on each retry, which used to break your other sessions with 401s too.
After /context, later turns no longer resend the whole visual grid to Claude; only the table is kept.

Auto mode: claude -p exits 1 in text and JSON output when actions were refused for lack of a safety check, auto mode is no longer wrongly refused when a model change and an auto mode request arrive together, /status stops claiming the server review is enabled when it isn't reaching the session, and very large permission rules or autoMode settings get an explanation and, without autoMode deny rules, a prompt.
On Linux, projects on network file systems (NFS, SMB, Lustre and similar) no longer have every file listed at start.

Once the server refuses feedback for your organization, Claude-drafted feedback, surveys and /feedback stop showing, and Claude no longer drafts feedback through third-party gateways that can't deliver it.
Bash deny and ask rules now catch commands written with quoted words.
Expanded subagent hand-back reports no longer show an internal marker and provenance note outside verbose mode.
If claude -p --resume with a prompt finds a deferred tool call whose MCP server is gone, it now keeps the call, exits with code 1 and won't accept more input.
SDK clients get informational messages in full, and Agent SDK hosts see a failed run's own error on a full disk instead of a generic exit-code error.

CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN no longer re-runs a turn interrupted in plan mode when the session resumes in another mode, and in VS Code a plan step interrupted that way stops with a notice after a reload instead of carrying out an unapproved plan.

Config files: edits to a settings file made seconds after Claude Code wrote it now count, a home holding a legacy-named config file gets a stderr note saying which is used, and a disk filling during a save in a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file no longer leaves ~/.claude.json, settings or edited files empty or cut off.
Write no longer ends the turn as a refusal when it can't read the file it would overwrite.
Bash: background commands that finish almost at once keep their output, and the diff of changed files includes a file written just before the command ended.
A mistyped model name such as opus-5-5 suggests the model you meant instead of telling you to update.
NotebookEdit no longer changes the wrong cell when the notebook changes during the permission prompt.
The /login success screen closes at once on Enter, with the refresh in the background, and Ctrl+G opens the external editor while typing an "Other" answer in screen reader mode.
Behind a proxy with CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS set on a machine without its own DNS, Monitor can now open WebSocket watches instead of failing to resolve the host.

Plugins: claude plugin eval stops suggesting max: 0 for a tool that must not be called, and background auto-update, claude plugin update and /plugin Update now install dependencies the new version added. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is substituted in a plugin's subagentStatusLine command.

A mod's hot reload in .claude/skills notices a file deleted right after it appeared, and its return, and no longer turns off when you send three messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session.
/rewind: restoring code to a checkpoint from before /branch works, and a restore can no longer write or delete a file through a directory symlink.
Read-only commands wrapped in a plain timeout DURATION, such as timeout 30 rg foo, no longer prompt needlessly.
WebFetch on a claude.ai shared-chat link explains it can't read shared chats and asks you to paste the conversation, rather than calling the page empty.
Artifact database calls aren't resent to artifacts without a database (errors say whether republishing helps), and reads that save to an out_dir folder are no longer refused.
OpenTelemetry: detailed beta tracing presents CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT to collectors that need it, and claude_code.session.count counts a pre-started Agent SDK process once, when claimed.

/clear no longer kills running commands of background agents, teammates and workflows that keep going, or foreground subagents of background agents and teammates, and on the web such background tasks stay in the task list.
After a Claude apps gateway sign-in expires, the terminal stops sending telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway would reject as invalid_token.

Agents view: a reply to a background session waiting on a permission prompt stays in the box with a hint to answer there, drafts and input from another agent view in the same folder are no longer removed or restored by mistake, and previews mark cut-off text with an ellipsis and keep **, backticks and tags in commands awaiting approval.

If the Chrome connection drops in the middle of an action, Claude in Chrome no longer claims the extension is disconnected, and Claude looks at the page before retrying something that may have already happened.
Remote Control on other devices stops showing "Limit reached" after a usage limit was lifted elsewhere, and the iOS app shows the file card when Claude sends a single file.

Self-hosted runners: when the server keeps refusing to renew model access, the runner retries sooner and warns in the session, a runner with --use-anthropic-git-proxy or --configure-git exits before registering after a failed startup check, and --trust-workspace false also stops hooks in the repository's settings files and skills.

Cloud sessions: /permissions explains where the session's rules live and how to change them, session-scoped deny and ask rules (such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds) survive a move to a new worker, and hidden commands no longer show in the slash menu on mobile and web.

Security fixes: a sed command could skip the permission check in accept-edits and auto mode, a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a Bash command from checks, and creating a worktree allowed a sandbox escape.
CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1 in managed settings applies behind a gateway whose URL is set only there when server-managed settings can't be fetched.
In Claude Desktop, deny and ask rules, hook matchers and disallowedTools entries using a claude.ai connector's terminal name (mcp__claude_ai_Slack) are honoured once Desktop includes this version.
After an update, idle background sessions that started through an LLM gateway exported in your shell keep using that gateway.

Behind a TLS-inspecting proxy with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC set, certificate errors can now clear: after a failure Claude Code performs a TLS handshake with the API host, through your http:// proxy if set, without sending an API request.
claude remote-control says why and exits 1 when its first-run question goes unanswered, and accepts a piped y without a newline as yes.
/rename warns that the name may not last when it can't be saved to the transcript.

Background agents: subagents aren't told after compaction to expect notices for agents they didn't start or take over, and a refused later report now says so and how to request it instead of vanishing.
Windows config saves wait longer for a file another program holds, so a kill mid-save is less likely to empty ~/.claude.json.
Claude in Chrome waits up to 6 seconds for the session's own browser after a brief disconnect, and keeps javascript_tool results up to 60,000 characters in the conversation.
claude purge and old-session cleanup retry folders they couldn't fully delete and report an error if one remains.
On macOS and Windows, refusing a path outside the working directories names the inside spelling when only letter case differs.
Artifact database errors are clearer when an update targets a missing document or the service pauses repeated refused writes.
Claude apps gateway: failed upstream warnings name the upstream, and the spend limit error reads like "spend limit reached · resets Dec 1", followed by admin.blocked_message if set.
The /model picker groups older models under a "More models" row.
/context keeps the table Claude reads short: each list holds its 10 largest rows, and on-demand MCP tools share one row per server until called.
In cloud sessions, /usage links to Settings → Usage on claude.ai when plan limits can't be shown.

MCP tasks now work in the terminal even when feature flags can't be fetched, such as on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways or with DISABLE_TELEMETRY; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1 disables them.
Once you switch auto mode's server-side check off outside a project, its settings files or a plugin can't switch it back on.
Monitor's WebSocket watch is now governed by your Bash rules: a deny blocks it, and when an ask rule applies, a Monitor allow rule, bypass mode or auto mode won't skip the prompt.
CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS can no longer come from settings files where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment.

Permission rules: a session's exact Bash or PowerShell ask rule is refused when a broader deny covers the command, and the Bash tool asks before running which with flags outside its lookup and display set.
--add-dir directories register plugin marketplaces only after their own trust dialog is accepted.
With the Bash sandbox on, skills from .claude/skills folders deeper than your starting folder load only when you start Claude Code in that folder or /cd into it.
A self-paced /loop now stops when a turn ends without scheduling the next run, instead of setting a backup wakeup; CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 brings back the old behavior.
Tool calls that complete after a new message interrupts the turn now still trigger PostToolUse hooks, which get up to 10 seconds.
After safeguards stop a subagent, Claude is told to retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, not to do the work itself.
When a cloud session moves to a new worker and can't carry all its deny and ask rules, its session-only allow rules are dropped, so you may be asked again.
Behind a TLS-inspecting proxy, the automatic certificate fix is skipped if only ALL_PROXY is set; point HTTPS_PROXY at the proxy's http:// address instead.
Artifact database saves of rows others may have written add a hidden marker file per file; existing files without one, including older exports, are left alone and reported.
/claude-api managed-agents-onboard templates match the Claude Console: Performance tuner is gone, two are renamed, and five that don't need it have web search and fetch off.
The built-in Claude in Chrome tools lose shortcuts_list and shortcuts_execute, which listed and ran shortcuts saved in the extension.
Gateway: when every upstream is Amazon Bedrock, Claude Desktop no longer offers a web search tool that can never work.
Self-hosted runners: CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH gives each repository its own folder, adding -2, -3 and so on to a taken name.
Self-hosted runners no longer upload a session's debug log at the end; a failed session's log stays on the host unless --remove-session-state is set.

VS Code: prompts over 50,000 characters stay in the box with a notice instead of being cut silently, survey and Report a problem buttons no longer send your unfinished prompt, Web tab cloud sessions no longer bring back turns removed by /clear, Retry or Edit, and renaming a deleted session no longer restores its file.

VS Code: no chat panel freeze for a dropped path with a very long run of slashes, toggleDictation acts only in the current view and stops on a second press, and replies with many shrinking unclosed $$ fences no longer slow the panel.

VS Code: the gateway "not signed in" message looks like an error with a Sign in link, the diagnostics tool omits files without problems, returns compact JSON and takes a minimum severity, and links in replies to Claude sign-in, connector or API addresses show as text.
Cloud sessions: scheduled tasks keep a connector named memory, mounted under that name plus a short suffix, and Send now on a waiting message no longer ends running background agents.
Cloud sessions: on self-hosted environments, the warning about a stalled setup now names and links your organization's default or an environment that has a live runner.
Code Review: unlinking a GitHub organization also turns off its All repositories setting, which stays off after relinking until you turn it on.

Claude Tag: setup can launch without picking a channel when the channel list can't fully load, and saving auto mode allow rules is refused with a message instead of overwriting another admin's changes.
Claude Tag: Enterprise organizations with it connected get a row on the Models admin page linking to where its model defaults are managed.
